review_scope: Exact full-resolution review of all five reference boards, 40 object crops, and all ten v4 card-sorting story pages.

checks: one complete unambiguous target per crop
cup/glass, plate/bowl, and spoon/fork/knife distinctions remain explicit
no text, people, food, liquid, logo, watermark, or competing object
page 01 visibly establishes disordered source cards, empty orderly board, helper, and nonlinguistic goal cue
pages 02-09 show exactly one active held card in frozen order while completed cards accumulate
page 10 visibly resolves the event with eight orderly cards, empty source, and helper celebration
all eight immutable photo identities persist exactly once per page
the agent is waist-up with stable proportions; no cropped legs or broken social composition
no object-specific matching position, learner-facing text, or extra table object is shown

crop_decision: Vocabulary panels are isolated because neighbors would compete as answers. Story pages remain full-frame because helper, source area, board, active card, and accumulated cards jointly express the event.
